long_biography.plain_text:
At St Therese Medical Center, Dr Fady Hachem combined hospital leadership with clinical work. The Hadath institution provides medical, surgical, maternity, paediatric and intensive-care services. His administrative responsibilities therefore reached beyond the specialist clinics in which he built his career.

Hachem earned his medical qualification at Saint Joseph University and pursued further training in France. His professional profile includes microsurgery at Pitié-Salpêtrière and surgical training at René-Dubos Hospital. He also worked across several Lebanese institutions, including Clinique du Levant and Tall Chiha Hospital, bringing international training into hospital and specialist practice.
